notes: Guard Mode allowlist now has a directory search — type a name or UPN to find and add a real Entra user instead of typing it by hand, with a raw-value option for service accounts and app IDs.
Allowlisted actors are shown as a sortable table with name, UPN, when they were added, and by whom. Requires the matching backend update for live search and added-dates to appear.
Changing Guard Mode (Off / Monitor / Auto-Restore) saves immediately with a Saving/Saved indicator.
